name: AI Shopping Assistant for WooCommerce – WoAssistCart AI
author: WoAssistCart

sections.description:
WoAssistCart AI brings conversational AI shopping to your WooCommerce store. Let customers find products, ask questions, manage carts, and complete purchases through natural conversation instead of complex navigation.

Your data, your control: Connect your own OpenAI or Google Gemini API key. No mandatory cloud services or third-party accounts required.

Get WoAssistCart Pro | Try Live Demo

Free Features

Core Shopping Assistant
AI-powered chat (floating widget or shortcode), natural language product search, product Q&A, smart recommendations, product comparison, cart management, order tracking.

Customization & Brand
Custom colors, avatar, greeting, launcher position, up to 3 Quick Actions.

Technical
OpenAI/Gemini support, 11+ languages, conversation memory, cost controls, GDPR-compliant, secure API key encryption.

Pro Features – Transform Browsers into Buyers

Get WoAssistCart Pro | Try Demo

🎯 Semantic & AI Product Search
Go beyond keyword matching with meaning-based product discovery. Customers say “something comfortable for long flights” and get travel pillows, compression socks, eye masks. Or “laptop that handles coding and stays cool” finds machines with powerful processors and cooling systems. Understands intent, use-cases, and scenarios — not just product names.

🤖 AI Sales Agent & Guided Selling
Transform casual browsing into confident purchases. The AI Sales Agent asks intelligent clarifying questions: “What will you use it for?” → “What’s your budget?” → “Any specific features?” Then recommends perfectly matched products. Like having an expert salesperson for every customer, 24/7. Increases conversions by guiding customers to the right products instead of overwhelming them with choices.

📋 Sales Playbooks
Create custom conversation flows for different product types. Electronics playbook asks about technical specs and compatibility. Clothing playbook asks size, style, occasion. Furniture playbook asks room dimensions and preferences. Each category gets its own expert selling strategy that consistently converts.

💰 AI-Powered Upsell & Cross-Sell
Intelligently suggest complementary products and upgrades based on conversation context. When customer adds camera, AI naturally mentions “Most photographers also grab a protective bag and spare battery for their first shoot.” Context-aware, not pushy. Increases average order value by 20-40% without annoying customers.

🛒 Abandoned Cart Recovery System
Automatically detect abandoned carts and send personalized recovery emails. Multi-step campaigns (1 hour, 24 hours, 3 days), AI-assisted email copywriting, branded templates with your logo and colors, custom CTAs, and smart scheduling. Recover 10-15% of abandoned carts and thousands in lost revenue every month.

🔔 Back-in-Stock Alerts
Never lose a sale to “out of stock.” Customers click to get notified when products return. Automated email alerts when inventory is back. Track product interest to understand demand. Works for all product types and variations. Convert “maybe later” into immediate sales.

📊 Analytics & Revenue Attribution
See exactly how AI impacts your bottom line. Track: total conversations, product searches, recommendations clicked, cart actions, conversion rates, orders influenced by AI, and revenue attributed to the assistant. Visual dashboards show “AI assistant contributed to 127 orders ($15,847) this month.” Make data-driven decisions about your shopping experience.

📚 AI Knowledge Base & RAG
Train your assistant with deep product knowledge beyond standard WooCommerce fields. Upload product manuals, care instructions, compatibility guides, assembly instructions, store policies, shipping information, return policies, and FAQs. Perfect for complex products or detailed policies. Customers get expert-level answers instantly.

🎙️ Voice & Image Shopping
Let customers shop how they want. Voice input for hands-free shopping (“Find me wireless headphones under $100”). Image search to find products matching photos (“Show me products like this”). Multimodal shopping experiences that feel futuristic and convenient.

🌍 Advanced Multilingual Capabilities
Enhanced language support with regional dialects, currency awareness, and cultural context. Serve global customers with localized experiences that feel native, not translated.

⚡ Priority Support
Get faster response times, dedicated assistance, and direct access to our development team. Your success is our priority.

💎 Real Results from Pro Users:
* “Cart recovery alone paid for Pro in the first month” – Sarah, Fashion Store
* “Semantic search increased our conversion rate by 23%” – Mike, Electronics
* “Analytics showed AI influenced $47K in sales last quarter” – Jennifer, Home Goods

Free vs Pro

Free includes:
AI chat, natural language search, product Q&A, recommendations, comparison, cart management, order tracking, Quick Actions, brand customization, 11+ languages, OpenAI/Gemini support, conversation memory, cost controls, privacy features.

Pro adds:
Semantic search, AI Sales Agent, Sales Playbooks, smart upsell/cross-sell, cart recovery, back-in-stock alerts, analytics & attribution, AI knowledge base, voice & image search, advanced multilingual, priority support.

Upgrade to Pro

External Services

WoAssistCart AI communicates with third-party AI providers only after you configure your own API key.

OpenAI

API Endpoint: https://api.openai.com
When Used: After you configure OpenAI and customers interact with assistant
Data Sent: Customer messages, assistant instructions, relevant product/cart info
Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Google Gemini

API Endpoint: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com
When Used: After you configure Gemini and customers interact with assistant
Data Sent: Customer messages, assistant instructions, relevant product/cart info
Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce
  2. Install WoAssistCart AI from Plugins → Add New or upload ZIP
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Go to WooCommerce → WoAssistCart AI
  5. Select AI provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini)
  6. Add your API key and test connection
  7. Enable floating assistant or use shortcode
  8. Customize appearance and settings

Shortcode: [woassistcart-ai] or [woassistcart_ai_chat]
sections.faq:
What is WoAssistCart AI?

An AI shopping assistant for WooCommerce that helps customers search products, ask questions, compare items, manage carts, and check orders through natural conversation.

Do I need an API key?

Yes, you need your own OpenAI or Google Gemini API key for AI-powered features. Get keys from:
* OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/
* Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/

What are API costs?

Most WooCommerce stores spend just a few dollars per month. The plugin includes optional daily token budgets to control costs.

Does it phone home?

No. The free plugin doesn’t send data to us. AI requests go directly to your configured provider (OpenAI or Gemini).

Can AI invent prices?

No. WooCommerce is always the source of truth for prices, stock, and product data.

Can customers add to cart?

Yes. Customers can add products, update quantities, and remove items through chat. All cart actions require confirmation.

Does it work with my theme?

The floating widget works with all themes. Use the shortcode for precise placement in page builders.

What languages are supported?

11+ languages with automatic detection: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Bengali, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese.

How do I get Pro?

Visit https://wooassistant.com/

Can I try it first?

Yes! Try the live demo: https://wooassistant.com/demo/

Is it GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Includes personal data export/erase support, conversation retention controls, and secure data handling.
